title: Prepare accountable judgments from explicit criterion coverage
statement: The Review and verification Module shall compose per-criterion support and contradictions with an assessor-supplied scoped judgment, withholding unsupported favorable reliance while preserving accountable meaning through recording.

what.problem: Assurance preparation and retention can conflate planned methods, actual observations, semantic judgment and current reliance.
what.desired_outcome: Prepare accountable judgments from explicit criterion coverage.

why.rationale: SR-028 needs accountable assurance content and failure semantics in MOD-007.

conditions: An assessor prepares or reassesses assurance content for a declared engineering claim.

contexts: MOD-007 contribution to MOD-017 IF-014; guided recording through MOD-012 and existing IF-004/003.

how.approach: Apply assurance-content.md to exact supplied bases, preserve gaps and actual actor decisions, then confirm selected retention separately.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-028 criteria within the declared finite claim; operational persistence and execution authority retain their existing owners.

acceptance_criteria: Account for every included criterion with applicable observations, contrary support, unresolved gaps and the assessor's semantic reasoning against an exact subject and criterion basis.
Leave claims with missing required support or unresolved material contradiction unestablished; a narrower conclusion requires explicit assessor-selected included and excluded scope.
Do not turn mechanically complete references, accepted exceptions or tradeoffs into observed satisfaction or action authority.

Identify gate purpose, actual contributors, assessor and required independence basis; requirement reuse can be accepted before architecture completion and Design review assesses the later completeness.
Preserve actual reviewer attribution, relied-on support and unresolved obligations through preparation and retention; work updates and successful storage never author or renew approval.
constraints: Target Design; no implemented automation, executed verification or requirement satisfaction is asserted.

sources.basis: Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
